verdict.rationale: Angular's repository points developers to an official upgrade guide (angular-gh-3). The CLI documents `ng update`, which "updates your workspace and its dependencies" and links to the Update Guide (angular-docs-15, angular-docs-25), giving a first-party, tooling-backed path to newer versions. Community complaints about breaking changes and the AngularJS-to-2 rewrite concern version churn, not the guide failing, so they don't create a dispute. Missing for 10: detail on the guide's content (version-by-version steps, migration schematics), hands-on reports of using the guide or `ng update` successfully.
